items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, did, did Barthede cook this powder on his hands too? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, but he had something to put it in his mouth too.

ctx.x: Well, I was on a show last year and a fella had the show. They used to shoot dice. And that man used to lift something in his hand all the time. And he went all the money all the time. Tell you his hand switched. I have to put this pot in my hand, my hand switched, you know. And they put that pot in and boy. He had loaded dice, that would put the food down. Well, it might have been loaded dice too. But I'm telling you, he won all the money every time he shoots dice, he won all the money.
Well, did, did Barthede cook this powder on his hands too? Yeah, he put it all the money. He chewed it and he put it on his hands both.
Yeah, but he had something to put it in his mouth too. Wow. Something like gum. Yeah. But it was black.
